title: Nuclei Isolation for SnRNA-seq and SnATAC-seq from Frozen Fresh Human Retina Sample
author: Xuesen Cheng
materials: Leave on ice for 3 min total.

steps.title: Prepare Eye Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the eye for dissection and imaging.

substeps.instruction: Remove optic nerve stalk with a blade and orbital fat with forceps from the eye.
Place the eye in a vial filled with 1X PBS and label the vial.
Keep eyes on Kimwipes wet by PBS in a dish and measure sagittal, transverse, and axial diameters using a caliper.
Place the eye in a cuvette to take fundus and OCT images.

steps.title: Remove Anterior Segment
steps.instruction: Isolate the posterior part of the eye by removing the anterior segment.

substeps.instruction: Place the eye on a folded wet Kimwipe or wet gauze for stability.
Under a microscope, make an incision just beneath the limbus with a new blade, using serrated forceps to stabilize the eye.
Use dissection scissors to cut around the limbus and remove the anterior segment (cornea, lens, and iris).
Separate the lens, cornea, and iris with forceps and place them into different tubes; note if the lens is artificial.

steps.title: Flatten Eye and Remove Vitreous
steps.instruction: Prepare the retina by flattening the eye and removing vitreous.

substeps.instruction: Make 4 cuts with dissection scissors between the eye muscle attachment points to flatten the eye into 4 separate lobes of tissue.
Carefully trim away as much vitreous as possible using VANNAS scissors without disturbing the retina.

steps.title: Isolate Fovea and Macula
steps.instruction: Extract specific retinal regions using punch biopsy tools.

substeps.instruction: Use a 2mm punch biopsy tool centered over the fovea to make an incision.
Use a 4mm punch biopsy tool centered over the macula to make an incision.
Carefully transfer the fovea and macula (excluding RPE or other tissues) into separate 2ml Punch tubes.
Label tubes and place in liquid nitrogen immediately, then store at -80℃ overnight.

steps.title: Separate Retinal Lobes and RPE/Choroid
steps.instruction: Separate the remaining retinal tissue into lobes and layers.

substeps.instruction: Use a razor blade to make an 'X' to separate the lobes; number lobes 1-4 clockwise, starting with the macula lobe.
For each lobe, carefully separate the retinal and RPE/choroid layers using forceps.
Store each sample (4 retinal lobes and 4 RPE/choroid lobes, 8 total) in 2ml tubes.
Label tubes and place in liquid nitrogen immediately, then store at -80℃ overnight.

steps.title: Collect Remaining Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect leftover tissue for DNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Collect remaining tissue in a 15ml Falcon tube.
Label tube and place in liquid nitrogen immediately, then store at -80℃ overnight.
Disinfect the bench with 70% ethanol.
Rinse tools in water before placing them in a container with 70% ethanol.

steps.title: Isolate Nuclei from Frozen Tissue
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical lysis to isolate nuclei from frozen retina blocks.

substeps.instruction: Cool razor blades, glass dounce homogenizer (1 ml), and RNAse-free lysis buffer on ice.
On dry ice, use a pre-cooled razor blade to cut a rice-grain-sized block of frozen retina and mince as small as possible.
Add 500 ul ice-cold RNase-free lysis buffer on wet ice and start the timer.
Pipet the tissue in lysis buffer 10 times with a P1000 pipet (set to 500ul) on wet ice to disrupt tissue.
Transfer the tissue to the precooled glass dounce.
Dounce the sample 10 times with a loose pestle and 10 times with a tight pestle, slowly and gently to avoid bubbles.
Filter the sample through 40um Flumi Cell Strainers into a 2ml ice-cold Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Process isolated nuclei for either snRNA-seq or snATAC-seq.

substeps.instruction: For snRNA-seq: Add DAPI (1ug/ml), FACS sort for nuclei immediately, and count concentration (target: 800-1000 nuclei/ul).
For snATAC-seq: Spin down the sample at 500 g for 5 min at 4℃.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet and resuspend the pellet in 50 ul diluted Nuclei Buffer (1X).
Stain nuclei with trypan blue and count concentration (target: 3000-5000 nuclei/ul).
